info.description:
Manages students, courses, and course rosters.

All error responses use the `ErrorResponse` schema unless an operation says otherwise.
Data is stored in memory and is cleared each time the service restarts.

schema.description: A student as returned by the API.

id.description: Unique id assigned by the service.

gpa.description: Grade point average on a 4.0 scale.

courses.description: Names of the courses this student is enrolled in, with one entry per course.

courses.description: Ids of the courses to enroll this student in. The student is added to the roster of each course. On an update, the list replaces the student's current courses.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth. Protected student data: it is accepted on write and is never returned by the API.

schema.description: The fields a client supplies to create or update a course.

instructor.description: Id of the instructor teaching the course.

maxSize.description: Maximum number of students the course can hold. It cannot be set below the number of students already on the roster.

roster.description: Ids of the students to place on the roster. When omitted from an update, the roster is left unchanged. Every id must belong to an existing student.
